amendments.change: BossController now has a kinematic Rigidbody + hitbox so PlayerCombat.Strike can deliver IDamageable damage; shielded hits show a SHIELDED! popup.

amendments.reason: playtest: red circles too subtle and interrupted spelling
amendments.change: Filled translucent disc + thicker ring, circles land outside the player's feet, warning 1.6s, max 2 circles, slower cooldowns, 1 letter lost on hit, no letter loss while actively spelling.

amendments.reason: playtest: one full-word box was not fun
amendments.change: Shield words are scattered as one smashable per letter across the clued room with two decoy caches; starter props are spread out too.

amendments.reason: user: letters must come out of real items, not letter boxes
amendments.change: Caches are recognisable props (BOOK, BAT, BED, SOFA, CLOCK, LAMP, MUG, SPEAR...). Smashable.Drops separates a prop's look from the letters it releases.

amendments.reason: user: a CLOCK dropping only C is abnormal
amendments.change: No prop has a forced single-letter drop. Cache props are chosen by greedy set cover so their OWN full letters contain the shield word (CLOCK drops C-L-O-C-K, CAKE drops C-A-K-E). Starter props also drop their own words. Cover is verified by tests for CALC/ULA/TOR.

amendments.reason: user: prepare phase needs a visible countdown and a hidden boss
amendments.change: Prepare is fixed at 20 s, shown in the top-centre countdown chip and the instruction line. During prepare the boss model, collider, shield rings, name and shield HUD are hidden; the HUD subtitle reads ??? until the countdown ends.
Reveal starts AoE and a random-room supply drop every 30 s (DeliverySpawner.Drop with Layout wired). AoE spawns a random burst of 1-3 circles per cooldown, capped by maxAoe 3.

amendments.reason: user: boss should summon chasing mini calculators
amendments.change: Minis spawn from 14 s then every 18 s, max 2 alive. Touch deals 0 HP damage, 0.18 s stagger, 3.5 knockback and 1 letter; a per-player 3 s cooldown, mini recoil and an already-staggered guard prevent chain stuns. Melee smashing one bursts CALC letters.

amendments.reason: user: shield break was not clear
amendments.change: Layer cracks and final break now show a large centre-screen flash, floating banners, Craft_Ring particles, stronger shake, boss wobble and a GO chip; SHIELDED! feedback remains for blocked hits.

amendments.reason: user: keep the pressure after the shield breaks
amendments.change: In the Hit phase the boss keeps normal circles and minis and adds a JUMP SMASH circle every 5 s: larger (2.4 m), short 1 s warning, 18 damage, lands close to the player so movement is required.

amendments.reason: user: five items means the WHOLE house, not five extra props on top of the authored furniture
amendments.change: BossFight.Restart clears the authored furniture snapshot with ResetRoom(furnish: false). The five director-spawned props are the only smashables in the house when prepare begins.

amendments.reason: user: a flat circle on the floor is not a boss jump smash
amendments.change: The boss physically leaps along an arc to the telegraphed landing spot during the warning, tilts in flight and squashes on impact; its hitbox travels with it. The circle marks the boss's landing point.

amendments.reason: user: add countdowns to all timed events and say where deliveries land
amendments.change: Supply drops, mini waves and jump smashes all show a top-chip 3-2-1 (eventWarnSeconds = 3). At fire the chip switches to a GO line naming the room/area; the smash announces itself when the marker appears.

amendments.reason: user: minis die in one hit and drop the real shield word
amendments.change: Mini calculators have 42 HP and a world-space health bar; per-swing damage is capped at half their max HP so at least two hits are needed. Breaking one bursts exactly one random A-Z letter instead of CALC. Touch never removes player HP.

amendments.reason: user: delivery spot must change every game
amendments.change: The drop point is chosen during the countdown via DeliverySpawner.PickDropPoint and delivered at that exact point via DropAt. Restart reseeds the RNG stream from the clock plus a run counter, so rooms differ between games.

amendments.reason: user: the fight was too difficult after the latest changes
amendments.change: Loosen the pressure: mini calculators first appear 25 s into each DropAndPrevent phase (was 14 s) and then every 40 s (was 18 s); the post-shield jump smash cooldown is 12 s (was 5 s). Countdowns, ranges and damage are unchanged.

amendments.reason: user: the loosening made the hit phase too boring
amendments.change: Bring some pressure back: mini repeat interval is 30 s (was 40 s; first wave stays at 25 s) and the post-shield jump smash cooldown is 6 s (was 12 s).

Three shield layers, each cracked by spelling its word, with stagger and slow-mo shatter
Shield letters scattered as separate smashable caches across a named LivingRoom room, plus two decoys
Chaos word spending from spare letters (ZAP/BEES/MAGNET)
Readable telegraphed red-circle AoE; hit damages and scatters one letter, never interrupts active spelling
Vulnerable hit phase: shield gate opens and existing melee/thrown damage applies
Preparing phase: scout rooms and craft one weapon from provided props
Boss damage formula and extreme checks
Boss HP 240 and time-to-kill targets
Retuned AoE table: 1.6s warning, 2 circle cap, 5.5/5.0/4.4/4.0s cooldowns, 1 letter lost
Letter economy production-to-consumption ratio
Rules config keys, whitelist and validation constraints
LivingRoom single-map segment structure with 4s stagger breathers
Silly party chaos style anchors and fixed hex palette
Calculator boss procedural primitive placeholder (~1.8m)
Filled translucent red disc plus thick pulsing warning ring (1.6-2.2m)
Boss HUD runtime canvas: word slots, shield pips, HP bar, timer
HUD information architecture and transitions between phases
Boss-mode audio cues built from existing GameFeedback cues
Boss has a kinematic rigidbody and hitbox so melee damage reaches IDamageable
Readable filled AoE telegraph that lands outside the feet and never interrupts spelling
Shield letters scattered as individual smashable caches with decoys

Every breakable releases its own complete letters; prop carriers are selected to cover each shield word naturally
20 s prepare countdown on the top banner; boss model, name and shield HUD hidden until reveal; only 5 starter props in the whole house
Reveal starts AoE plus one random-room supply drop every 30 s; AoE bursts randomly spawn 1-3 circles
Chasing mini calculators: zero HP damage, knockback, 0.18 s stagger, one letter, anti-chain cooldown; smashable for CALC letters
Unmistakable shield-break feedback: centre flash, banners, particles, shake, boss wobble and GO chip
Post-break jump smash every 5 s alongside continued circles and minis
Exactly five smashable props in the whole house at start; authored furniture is cleared for this mode
Jump smash is a real arced boss leap onto the telegraphed landing spot with squash impact
3-2-1 countdown for supply drops, mini waves and jump smashes, with the delivery room announced on arrival
Mini calculators have 42 HP, a health bar, multi-hit deaths and one random A-Z letter on break

Mini calculators first appear at 25 s and repeat every 40 s; jump smash cooldown is 12 s after the shield breaks
